title: SHAP-Seeded GA Initialization — Accelerate Convergence via Feature Importance Bias

source.paper: Integration of machine learning XGBoost and SHAP models for NBA game outcome prediction and quantitative analysis methodology
source.key_finding: SHAP values for NBA XGBoost models consistently rank the same 20-30 features as highest importance across seasons. These stable top features drive >80% of predictive signal.

secondary_source.paper: Stacked ensemble model for NBA game outcome prediction analysis
secondary_source.key_finding: Rolling momentum features (3, 5, 10 game windows), rest days, and travel fatigue are the top-ranking features across multiple model types. SHAP alignment across models validates cross-model importance.

motivation: Our GA currently initializes each population uniformly at random from 3290 feature candidates. The SHAP paper shows that only ~30 features drive >80% of XGBoost predictive power for NBA. If we bias GA initialization to always include these top-30 SHAP features (2x selection probability), we should converge faster and avoid wasting generations on low-signal features.

steps: 1. After each completed cycle, run SHAP on the Pareto-best model: shap.TreeExplainer(best_model).shap_values(X_val)
2. Compute |mean SHAP| per feature across validation set → rank all features
3. Store top-30 SHAP feature indices as 'shap_seeds' in island state
4. During next generation's random initialization, set selection probability of shap_seeds features to 2x (vs 1x for others)
5. This biases ~50% of new individuals to include at least half the SHAP top features
6. Crossover and mutation unchanged — only init is biased
implementation.code_sketch: shap_probs = np.ones(n_features); shap_probs[top30_indices] *= 2.0; shap_probs /= shap_probs.sum(); selected = np.random.choice(n_features, size=n_select, replace=False, p=shap_probs)
implementation.shap_cost: ~0.5s per evaluation on CPU (TreeExplainer is fast for tree models)

expected_impact.convergence_speed: 30-50% fewer generations to reach equivalent Brier
expected_impact.mechanism: Fewer wasted generations evaluating random low-signal feature combinations
expected_impact.risk: LOW — init bias only, does not change mutation/crossover dynamics

cross_repo.political_note: Political alpha engine has 309 feature candidates vs NBA's 3290. SHAP seeding even more valuable with smaller feature space — expected top-15 SHAP features to get 3x weight.
cross_repo.rotation: Apply to political during Rotation B (Engineering) next cycle

prerequisite: SHAP library already in requirements (shap>=0.41.0). Verify import on HF Space.
